Markets.title: Father time always wins! What Warren Buffett’s 4-word farewell message means
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett has handed over leadership of Berkshire Hathaway to his son, Howard. While reflecting on aging, Buffett noted his unease with current speculative trends in the stock market.

Markets.summary: Trans ACNR Solutions and eight other companies have filed initial public offering papers with the Securities and Exchange Board of India. Maharashtra Oil Extractions plans to raise up to Rs 370 crore through its offering to fund expansion and manage debt.

Markets.summary: Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty ended higher on Friday, closing at 73,896 and 23,140.50 respectively. Strong domestic liquidity supported the market, while high crude prices and foreign outflows limited further gains ahead of Monday's trade.

Markets.summary: SEBI's new PRIM framework lowers the Portfolio Management Services entry limit to Rs 25 lakh. This change expands professional portfolio management to an estimated 2 to 3 crore Indian investors.

Markets.title: Joel Tillinghast’s Stock-Picking Secrets: Why investors should Look Beyond the Share Price
Markets.summary: Veteran stock picker Joel Tillinghast advises investors to focus on deep business analysis and strong competitive advantages rather than volatile share prices. He also recommends holding onto promising investments for the long term while avoiding critical blunders.

Geo-Political.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
Geo-Political.summary: Iran's foreign minister stated that negotiation is the only way to end the conflict in the Strait of Hormuz. This response followed U.S. President Trump's rejection of a proposed deal, though Tehran is still waiting for official notification.

Geo-Political.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
Geo-Political.summary: Two separate mass shootings in South Africa resulted in a total of 27 deaths. These incidents occurred within hours of each other amid ongoing struggles with high levels of gang-related armed violence in the country.

Geo-Political.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
Geo-Political.summary: Lawyers for Christa Pike are seeking clemency to prevent her scheduled execution for the 1995 murder of a fellow student. Her defense argues she was also a victim and would not receive the death penalty if tried today.

Geo-Political.title: Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
Geo-Political.summary: An avalanche struck a Himalayan climbing group preparing to scale the Himlung Himal peak. Rescuers found two bodies and are searching for at least 10 missing Nepalese guides and workers.

Geo-Political.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
Geo-Political.summary: Four people died in a helicopter crash near Montreal, Canada. Quebec provincial police have not yet identified the victims.

Geo-Political.summary: A powerful nor'easter storm struck New York and New Jersey, resulting in one death. Tens of millions of residents from Maine to Virginia were affected by the severe weather system.

Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 1, major appliance and consumer electronics manufacturers will raise prices by 5% to 8%. This price increase affects popular festive season purchases, including air conditioners, LED TVs, and washing machines.

Data & Insights.title: Sitharaman on India’s 10%+ growth potential: Startups and technology can drive next phase
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman stated that startups and technology can help India achieve over 10% economic growth. She emphasized that reaching this higher growth level to support Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat will require significant effort from all sectors of society.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex fall by $14.9 billion in a week, says RBI: Where do reserves stand now?
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $14.9 billion in a single week, according to data from the Reserve Bank of India. This decrease was primarily driven by a decline in foreign currency assets, which make up the largest component of the reserves.

Data & Insights.title: India's financial, external sectors remain resilient despite global risks: RBI bulletin
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported that the country's financial and external sectors remain resilient despite global risks. This economic strength is supported by strong Q1 growth, a five-year high in net FDI, robust exports, and $765.9 billion in foreign exchange reserves.

Data & Insights.title: CEA flags US friction, energy shocks, and missing AI play as India’s key near-term risks
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran warned that trade coercion, weaponized supply chains, and rising US bond yields pose significant near-term risks to India. He stated that these global pressures require India to adopt a costlier hedging strategy and a new economic playbook.

Data & Insights.title: India’s growth outlook strengthens as economists see resilient incomes, stable policy: WEF
Data & Insights.summary: According to a WEF survey, 74% of economists expect India's economic growth to be strong or very strong over the next year. This improved outlook is driven by resilient domestic consumption and stable policy expectations.

India.title: Students Deny 'Rape' In Video Released By Punjab's Lovely Professional University, Then Call It Scripted
India.summary: Students at Lovely Professional University vandalized their campus and set fire to buildings during protests over unverified claims of a student's sexual assault and suicide. A newly released video shows these same students denying the rape allegations and claiming their initial protest was scripted.

India.title: Suvendu Adhikari Says Bengal Will Protect Cows, Jail People Who Insult Monks
India.summary: At a Bhagavad Gita recital in Kolkata, West Bengal opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari stated that the state will protect cows and imprison those who insult monks. He also assured the audience that there is no need to fear practicing or promoting their faith.

India.title: In Rajasthan Civic Polls, BJP Scoops Up 204 Boards, Congress Trails With 96
India.summary: The BJP won 204 urban local body boards in the Rajasthan civic polls, while the Congress trailed with 96. The BJP notably secured seven out of nine boards in the tribal-dominated districts of Banswara, Dungarpur, and Pratapgarh.

India.title: 3-Day Bank Strike Deferred After Meeting Between Association, Unions
India.summary: The United Forum of Bank Unions postponed its planned three-day nationwide strike. The decision followed a meeting between the bank unions and the Indian Banks' Association.

India.title: UP Makes Display Of 'Use By Date' Mandatory For All Sweets
India.summary: Uttar Pradesh has made it mandatory for all sweet manufacturing and retail outlets to display the "use by date" on their products. Inspections showed that consumers were previously not being provided with clear information regarding the manufacture and expiry dates of sweets.

India.title: 2 Children Killed, Their Mothers Injured After Water Tank Collapses In Gurugram
India.summary: A water tank collapse in Gurugram killed two children and injured their mothers. Police registered a complaint against the contractor under the BNS and launched an investigation.
